items.distractor_fact: دمای هوا در ایستگاه هواشناسی شهر مجاور، در همان روز {D} درجه سانتی‌گراد ثبت شد.
items.gloss_en: The temperature at the weather station in the neighboring city was recorded as {D} degrees C on the same day.
items.entity_note: different place: a weather station in a neighboring city, not the one whose end-of-day/start-of-day readings are asked about
